source.note: The listed fields of every visual, in the manifest catalogOrder, copied unchanged from the manifest at the pinned rev. Data only: the shader bytes are in glsl300/.

visuals.name: Pulse
visuals.header: // Pulse: Black-room solar core: breathing disk, prismatic corona rings, treble sparks.

visuals.name: Starfield
visuals.header: // Starfield: Warp-speed hyperspace; streaks lock to tempo.

visuals.name: Crystal
visuals.header: // Crystal: Faceted gem refracting; fractures on transients.

visuals.name: Reactor
visuals.header: // Reactor: Fusion core with orbiting spectrum arcs and sparks.

visuals.name: Chrome
visuals.header: // Chrome: Raymarched liquid-metal blob, accent reflections.

visuals.name: Tunnel
visuals.header: // Tunnel: Opaque 3D flythrough; speed locks to BPM.

visuals.name: Terrain
visuals.header: // Terrain: Pulse-array city skyline with a floor grid and a hot waveform river.

visuals.name: Plasma
visuals.header: // Plasma: Domain-warped plasma: bass folds the field, treble frays it into glints.

visuals.name: Dunes
visuals.header: // Dunes: Topographic neon wire landscape with beat crests.

visuals.name: Cymatics/Prism
visuals.header: // Cymatics/Prism: A prismatic cymatics ring with audio-carved contours.

visuals.name: Spectral City
visuals.header: // Spectral City: A pulse-array skyline over a glossy black floor.

visuals.name: Waveform
visuals.header: // Waveform: Prismatic oscilloscope threads: stacked spectral wave wires with transient pins on black.

visuals.name: Bloom
visuals.header: // Bloom: Aurora ink clouds with bass light-leak portals and electric treble veins over black.

visuals.name: Drift
visuals.header: // Drift: Liquid-glass caustic linework over dark glass; artwork becomes a low-frequency tint.

visuals.name: Vinyl
visuals.header: // Vinyl: Luminous record grooves with beat needle sparks.

visuals.name: Ribbons
visuals.header: // Ribbons: Layered silk-light ribbons with spectral edge highlights.

visuals.name: Ripple
visuals.header: // Ripple: Beat-thrown cymatics ripples; newborn rings blaze gold, older rings cool to cyan-violet.

visuals.name: Petals
visuals.header: // Petals: Spectral flower rosette with beat-blooming edges.

visuals.name: Circuit
visuals.header: // Circuit: Beat pulses through a neon circuit board.

visuals.name: Spectrum
visuals.header: // Spectrum: Neon glass skyline: spectrum columns, spark shafts, circuit floor, molten waveform ribbon.

visuals.name: Lattice
visuals.header: // Lattice: Prismatic cymatics ring: rainbow contour wires in perspective with glossy floor reflection.

visuals.name: Murmuration
visuals.header: // Murmuration: Flock of light: three band-driven sub-flocks over a dark reflective floor; bass hits rupture the murmuration like a predator strike.

visuals.name: Ink
visuals.header: // Ink: Luminous ink in dark water: onsets drop dye charges colored by timbre, kicks send buoyant plumes mushrooming upward; the feedback buffer is the fluid.

visuals.name: Vault
visuals.header: // Vault: The song as architecture: a slow glide through raymarched halls whose rooms follow the track's sections — ribs pulse on the beat, treble lights the clerestory.

visuals.name: Loom
visuals.header: // Loom: The song, woven: the shuttle lays live spectrum as glowing weft while already-woven history recedes to the horizon; bass ripples travel back through the cloth.

visuals.name: Lens
visuals.header: // Lens: Sound as mass: band-driven bodies lens a nebula (or the artwork) with chromatic dispersion; sustained energy inspirals them into a black hole with a photon ring.

visuals.name: Photo Prism
visuals.header: // Photo Prism: Album/photo texture refracted into a circular waveform lens.

visuals.name: Memory Tunnel
visuals.header: // Memory Tunnel: Photo tiles stretched into a beat-pulsing perspective corridor.

visuals.name: Photo Particles
visuals.header: // Photo Particles: Image dissolves into chromatic spectrum particles.

visuals.name: Photo Glass
visuals.header: // Photo Glass: Photo-textured translucent towers on a reflective black floor.

visuals.name: Photo Liquid
visuals.header: // Photo Liquid: Photo melts into fluid ink and neon veins.

visuals.name: Photo Topography
visuals.header: // Photo Topography: Photo-derived heightfield as glowing contour terrain.

visuals.name: Photo Lens
visuals.header: // Photo Lens: Shattered mirrored photo shards inside a chromatic lens.

visuals.name: Photo gallery
visuals.header: // Photo gallery: Floating hologram photo cards drifting in depth.

visuals.name: Photo Curtain
visuals.header: // Photo Curtain: Photo converted into vertical spectral light curtains.

visuals.name: Photo Veil
visuals.header: // Photo Veil: Photo texture embedded in translucent aurora ribbons.

visuals.name: Particles
visuals.header: // Particles: GPU swarm bursting on the beat.

visuals.name: Kaleidoscope
visuals.header: // Kaleidoscope: Spectrum folded into a morphing mandala.

visuals.name: Helix
visuals.header: // Helix: Double-helix spectral ribbons with beat sparks.

visuals.name: Rain
visuals.header: // Rain: Neon spectrum rain over a glossy black floor.

visuals.name: Constellation
visuals.header: // Constellation: Audio-reactive node network with travelling links.

visuals.name: Comets
visuals.header: // Comets: Orbital comet trails crossing a dark stage.

visuals.name: Glyph
visuals.header: // Glyph: Rotating spectral sigil with broken rings and radial bars.

visuals.name: Nebula
visuals.header: // Nebula: Volumetric fluid/smoke stirred by bands.

visuals.name: Aurora
visuals.header: // Aurora: Undulating volumetric light curtains.

visuals.name: Phosphor Scope
visuals.header: // Phosphor Scope: Vintage CRT oscilloscope in a dark room: bass-vs-mid Lissajous figures morph with timbre, the beam kicks on onsets, and phosphor persistence smears the trace into glowing memory.

visuals.name: Oscillo Ring
visuals.header: // Oscillo Ring: The waveform bent into a closed ring: a live radial trace breathes on bass, echo rings detach and decay outward on every beat, and treble sparks orbit the rim.

visuals.name: Seismograph
visuals.header: // Seismograph: Four recording pens (bass, mid, treble, flux) draw scrolling traces on ruled paper; onsets jolt the needles, beats leave tick-marks, and heavy flux bleeds the ink.

visuals.name: Wave Cascade
visuals.header: // Wave Cascade: A live trace rides the top of the frame; each beat shears off a sheet of it that falls, fades, and stacks into a luminous waterfall while onsets fling spray off the crest.

visuals.name: Strata Ridge
visuals.header: // Strata Ridge: Unknown Pleasures, elevated: a stack of waveform traces recedes upward in perspective, near ridges occluding the old; bass lifts the live peaks, onsets race a shimmer along the front ridge.

visuals.name: Wave Tunnel
visuals.header: // Wave Tunnel: Fly down a tunnel extruded from the trace history: every depth ring is a past waveform slice, beats lurch the camera forward, onsets flash the nearest ring, timbre tilts the flight path.

visuals.name: Interference
visuals.header: // Interference: Bass, mid and treble each radiate circular wavefronts shaped by their own trace; where crests align the water burns HDR-hot with moiré shimmer, and every beat re-anchors the emitters with a soft shockwave.

visuals.name: Filament
visuals.header: // Filament: A single elastic string plucked by the music: band-weighted standing-wave harmonics decay between beats, node beads glow with their harmonic, and bass bows the whole span.

visuals.name: Mirror Bloom
visuals.header: // Mirror Bloom: A living Rorschach: band traces folded around the mirror axis shape an ink-blot that breathes with amplitude, feathers its edges with treble, and throws symmetric splatter on flux.

visuals.name: Braid
visuals.header: // Braid: Three luminous threads — bass, mid, treble — braid around a shared axis in pseudo-3D: each thread rides its own band trace, beatPhase drives the twist, and crossings spit sparks on the beat.

visuals.name: Liquid Optics
visuals.header: // Liquid Optics: Artwork through rippling glass: fbm water refraction, chromatic split, HDR caustic web, bass ripple bursts.

visuals.name: Volumetric Light
visuals.header: // Volumetric Light: Projector haze: band-driven beam fan with HDR spines, drifting dust motes, light leaks along the frame.

visuals.name: Event Horizon
visuals.header: // Event Horizon: Gravitational vortex: sheared spiral accretion arms, doppler beaming, HDR photon ring, infalling embers, absolute black core.

visuals.name: Prism Room
visuals.header: // Prism Room: Faceted caustic chamber: kaleidoscopic glass panes lit per band, caustic sweeps on the beat, HDR edge filaments and vertex glints.

visuals.name: Lumen Field
visuals.header: // Lumen Field: Field of spectral light pillars on a mirror floor: HDR tip orbs, rising energy pulses, rippled reflections.

visuals.name: Laser Tunnel
visuals.header: // Laser Tunnel: Wireframe laser flythrough: polygonal frames and corner rails with HDR cores, rotating sweep beam, beat shock frames.
